text:
Maya Patel: quick check — where are we on the marketplace listing timeline for the Nimbus HW bundle + SI joint blog? need press windows locked by EOD Fri :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tom Nguyen: we have draft sec on partner assets, but waiting on HW logos and final legal copy from @Rachel Kim
Len Ortiz: infra/sku pages mostly ready. just need marketplace SKU IDs from HW team. can prod them if needed
Rachel Kim: on it. sending legal-approved blurb by noon. need confirmation on whether joint press is co-branded or vendor-led
Maya Patel: vendor-led preferred but co-brand ok if Nimbus wants joint quote. pls note in the rundown
Oliver Price: PR - target embargo for bloggers is Tues 10am PT. official press for weds 7am PT. want approval on embargo timing
Jake S.: SI side: we need a short integration guide (1 pager) + contact for triage during day 0. I can draft the guide by tomorrow EOD
Maya Patel: perfect. can you also add a short troubleshooting FAQ paragraph? keeps CS happy
Jake S.: yep — will include FAQ + runbook stub. tagging eng-bot to record the doc link when ready
eng-bot: document created: https://redwood.docs/sdks/nimbus-integration-guide v1.0 (auto-tagged)
Tom Nguyen: putting together the go-live assets list. rough timeline snippet:
```
- Mon: final assets in repo (logos, copy, 1-pager)
- Tue 9am PT: press embargo emails go out to key outlets
- Tue 5pm PT: landing page staging cutover
- Wed 7am PT: public announcement + blog post
- Wed 9am PT: marketplace listing goes live
- Wed-Fri: SI onboarding office hours
```
Maya Patel: that looks good. @Rachel Kim and @Oliver Price — legal + PR confirm?
Rachel Kim: approved for vendor-led + co-brand fallback. will send final blurb by 11:45
Oliver Price: PR confirmed embargo window. will route embargo list + outreach plan by EOD today
Len Ortiz: one ops note — we should pin a downgrade fallback to a smaller model on the hosted route for first 48h in case of rate spikes (ops cost). cc product and eng-platform
Maya Patel: good call. add that to runbook. Tom, can you own the rollback/fallback note in the launch playbook?
Tom Nguyen: yep, adding fallback section now. will link to runbook and tag @eng-bot when done
eng-bot: snippet added to playbook: /playbooks/marketplace-nimbus-golive v2.1
calendar-bot: reminder created: Marketplace Announcement — Wed 07:00 PT (invitees: partnerships, PR, product, eng-platform)
Maya Patel: thanks team. final ask: anyone see any blockers not captured here?
Len Ortiz: HW team asked for an extra dev sandbox for SI validation. if we can spin that up by tomorrow morning we're all green
Maya Patel: ok I'm pinging Nimbus AMs now. if we can't get sandbox, we push inner validation to Tue morning and keep public dates same (tight but doable)
Oliver Price: heads-up, one outlet asked for an embargo exception for early hands-on. will DM Maya with details
Maya Patel: cool, thx. wrap up — I'll compile final checklist and post the link here after lunch :white_check_mark:
calendar-bot: event updated: Marketplace Announcement — Wed 07:00 PT (agenda attached)
